column2: W-what should we do?
Isn't it obvious!!
We change Gomorrah's way of doing things, right!?
You must not think about this so emotionally!
At the very least, Lord $$ベルフェ$$'s way of thinking is not entirely wrong.
More than that, I am troubled that Sodom's people hid those living in the slums...
Are they discriminating against people who can no longer work!?
Whatever approach one takes,
creating a society without any distortion is nearly impossible!!
Then what exactly do you intend to do?
I wish to entrust this question to you.
Sodom's approach, in which people are spirited and industry can readily prosper,
and each resident has $$自由$$, but disparities between rich and poor arise,
so making money may take priority over all else and destroy the natural environment—
or Gomorrah's approach!
There, people's $$自由$$ and speech are suppressed, robbing them of vitality, but...
in one sense everyone has $$平等$$, with no fear for their livelihood in illness, unemployment, or old age,
though a failure in the long-term plan itself could bring the entire city to ruin!!
Which is the more desirable vision of the future...?
What do you think?
Yeah, I want to hear what you think too!
It may seem like I am passing the responsibility to you, but I want you to decide!!
Sodom is better
Gomorrah is better
I cannot say either is better
That's right! I do not like $$ベルフェ$$'s way of doing things!
$$平等$$ that can only be achieved through control is wrong!
I cannot say that is wholly so, but let us persuade Gomorrah's army for now.
I like Gomorrah better too, because it even thinks about people who can no longer work!
This is not simple enough to judge by what one likes or dislikes, but...
let us persuade Sodom's army for now.
